# Lotus

> Local QR code management by Eco Development Studios.

Lotus lets users create, customize and manage QR codes locally in a web browser, without a database or a microservice deployment.

## Public pages

- [Lotus](https://lotus.ecostudios.dev/): product overview.
- [Sitemap](https://lotus.ecostudios.dev/sitemap.xml): public page list.
- [Eco Development Studios](https://www.ecostudios.dev/): publisher.
